input: Retail P2P interest is taxable under Section 56 (Income from Other Sources) of the Income-tax Act, 1961. Deductions are governed by Section 57. The bad-debt mechanism under Section 36(1)(vii) requires the debt to have been taken into account in computing income, per the conditions in Section 36(2).
